Bumrah's five-wicket match haul in the first Test against New Zealand, which ended in a draw, earned him a significant jump in the latest standings.

stories.title: Traveller gets confirmed berth number 54 in a train coach with only 52 berths, viral video leaves passeng
stories.summary: Booking a train ticket is a small act of trust. Going through the process of paying, waiting, and watching the status change from waiting to confirmed gives a quiet sense of relief. That is exactly what Ishan Bajpai did before boarding a night train from Varanasi City to Gorakhpur.

stories.title: Punjab Kings appoint Paras Mhambrey as fast bowling coach
stories.summary: Punjab Kings have appointed Paras Mhambrey as their fast bowling coach ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL). The former India pacer was previously with Mumbai Indians. The 54-year-old, who played 91 first-class games for Mumbai between 1992 and 2003 besides five international games for India, comes to the Punjab-based franchise with loads of coaching experience.

stories.title: Dottin out to 'free ball' after historic WBBL decision
stories.summary: A bizarre dismissal in the Women's Big Bash saw Brisbane Heat's Sarah Glenn bowling to an empty set of stumps , external after Melbourne Renegades new batter Deandra Dottin was ruled to have taken too long to face the delivery.

stories.title: Bellingham plays down Zidane comparison after wonder goal
stories.summary: Spanish football reporter at Bernabeu Published 10 minutes ago Manager Jose Mourinho described Jude Bellingham as "without any doubt, the best midfielder in the world" following a wonder goal which inspired a brilliant second-half performance for Real Madrid in a 5-1 win against PSV .

stories.title: Why Ben Stokes could become the costliest player at the IPL auction
stories.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes could emerge as the costliest buy at the upcoming IPL mini-auction, scheduled to be held in Goa on December 16. Stokes, who has represented three IPL franchises in the past, is expected to trigger a bidding war between Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR).

stories.title: ‘ICC, boards need to step in’: Harbhajan on India-Pakistan cricket skirmishes
stories.summary: The last couple of India-Pakistan cricket contests, while they've provided plenty of excitement, have also seen ugly scenes of skirmishes between the players. On November 14, India's Under-19 players had a go at their Pakistani counterparts, celebrating wildly and overenthusiastically after pipping their arch-rivals by one wicket in a thrilling Under-19 Asia Cup final at Al Amerat in Oman.

stories.title: Champions League: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real Madrid thump PSV; Arsenal and Man City held
stories.summary: Jude Bellingham came off the bench to score a spectacular goal as ​Real Madrid maintained their perfect Champions League start with a 5-1 comeback victory over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), while ‌Arsenal were held 1-1 at home by Borussia Dortmund and Manchester City drew ​2-2 with Napoli.

stories.title: Ashwin Hebbar has struck it rich as a middle-order finisher in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy
stories.summary: For much of his career, Ashwin Hebbar was an opening batter. To improve his chances of landing an IPL contract, he made the decision to reinvent himself in the middle order. He informed the selectors and the State association of his decision and in the ongoing Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy has made a seamless transition as a finisher.

stories.title: Raheem Sterling avoids jail after Lamborghini crash while inhaling laughing gas
stories.summary: Raheem Sterling has received a suspended prison sentence after admitting dangerous driving while inhaling nitrous oxide from a balloon during a rush-hour journey that ended with his £270,000 Lamborghini crashing into a roadside barrier. He must also complete 100 hours of unpaid community service and has been disqualified from driving for two years.

stories.title: Three Fort Hood shooting survivors lose final appeal to witness Nidal Hasan’s execution
stories.summary: Three survivors of the shooting at Fort Hood will not be allowed to witness the execution of Nidal Hasan, who fatally shot 13 people in the attack at the Texas Army post in 2009, military officials said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Hasan was found guilty of multiple counts of murder and attempted murder related to those killed and the more than 30 who were wounded by gunfire in the attack.

stories.title: ‘50-ball 200 is crazy’: Jacob Oram weighs in on Sooryavanshi as ODI's 'saviour'
stories.summary: Sooryavanshi has taken the cricketing world by storm with his astonishing exploits, most recently smashing a breathtaking 204 off just 53 balls in a List A match on Tuesday. The knock has also reignited the debate over the relevance of ODI cricket amid the growing popularity of T20s.

stories.title: India, Pakistan players' conduct shameful: Harbhajan
stories.summary: India versus Pakistan cricket matches across levels and age groups have recently been marred by ill-behaviour from players of both sides, and former India spinner Harbhajan Singh believes it is time for the International Cricket Council (ICC) and the respective Boards to step in. At the recent U-19 Asia Cup, players from both sides engaged in some over-the-top celebrations after winning.

stories.title: India tour of New Zealand: New Zealand vs India second Test in Christchurch preview
stories.summary: On October 20, the Men in Blue arrived from India, shook off the jetlag and began their tour with a stunning victory in the first T20I. Five weeks later, their counterparts in whites are back on the South Island, hoping to replicate those heroics and sign off with a Test victory that would complete a series whitewash.

stories.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom
stories.summary: Donald Trump awarded Rudy Giuliani, his former personal attorney who was disbarred for his efforts to help the US president overturn 2020 election results , with the presidential medal of freedom on Tuesday. “I am honored and humbled to receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom from my nation and from President Donald J Trump,” Giuliani, 82, wrote in an X post hours after the award had been presented to him.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi smashes fastest List A double hundred
stories.summary: India’s teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi etched his name in the history books on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), shattering the world record for the fastest double hundred in List A cricket with a 52-ball blitz against the UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. Sooryavanshi surpassed the record held by Chad Bowes, who scored a 200 off 103 balls for Canterbury against Otago in the Ford Trophy in 2024.

stories.title: 17-year wait: India stares at historic Test series win when it faces New Zealand in second Test on Friday
stories.summary: India will look to end their 17-year wait for a Test series victory in New Zealand when they take on the hosts in the second and final Test at Hagley Oval on Friday, with both sides seeking an advantage after the opening match ended in a draw at Wellington.

stories.title: Zaheer Khan's Anchor Sports Partners With German Cricket Federation To Launch 'Equal', A First-Ever Mixed-Gender T20 League
stories.summary: New Delhi, November 25, 2026: Anchor Sports AB, the Stockholm-based sports company, co-owned by 2011 World Cup-winning champion Zaheer Khan and IT tech entrepreneur Nagendra Siddoutam, announces its partnership with German Cricket Federation (Deutscher Cricket Bund), to unveil ‘Equal’, an innovative mixed-gender T20 cricket league, being developed in collaboration with Germany’s national cricket governing body.

stories.title: Malaysia Beat Thailand 4-0; India To Face Japan In Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 | VIDEO
stories.summary: Women's Asian Champions Trophy Bhopal: Today is the final day of the league stage of the Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 in Bhopal. The day began with Malaysia defeating Thailand 4-0 on Wednesday. The match between China and Korea began at 4:45 PM, while the final match of the day, between hosts India and Japan, is scheduled for 7 PM.

stories.title: USA joint bid and UK confirmed as 2031 and 2035 FIFA Women's World Cup hosts
stories.summary: FIFA on Monday (November 23, 2026) confirmed that a joint bid led by the United States will host the expanded, 48-team Women's World Cup in 2031, while the United Kingdom will host the following edition in 2035.

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. The couple shared a video on Instagram explaining their monthly expenses. Their spending includes groceries, household help, gym memberships , grooming, food and travel.

stories.title: Why BJP is keen on renaming West Bengal ‘Paschim Banga’? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 23, 2026, West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the State will be referred to as ‘Paschim Banga’ in all languages including English. Mr. Adhikari said the State Cabinet had passed the proposal and a new resolution to the effect would be tabled in the Assembly on December 9.

stories.title: Can a will be executed during hospitalization?
stories.summary: There is no legal restriction on executing a will during hospitalisation. The law does not require a testator (will-maker) to be in peak physical condition when making a will, provided he is of ‘sound mind’, that is, he has adequate mental capacity to understand his actions and their consequences.

stories.title: Can daughters be denied ancestral property if father died before 2005? Karnataka HC rejects sister-in-laws claims
stories.summary: The Karnataka High Court has upheld the daughters' rights over ancestral property during a recent case. The rights of six daughters in their father's ancestral property were denied by two wives of their late brother, after which the daughters moved court. According to a report by the Economic Times, the court granted each of them a 1/7th share as their two sister-in-laws failed to establish that the land had previously been partitioned.

stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: ​The Tata family tree explained​
stories.summary: A family divided over the future of the Tata empire. Jimmy Tata has accused his half-brother Noel Tata of trying to consolidate family control over Tata Trusts and Tata Sons. As the dispute over governance and control intensifies, we trace the family ties connecting Jamsetji, Ratan, Jimmy and Noel Tata.

stories.title: Who is Hima Ninama? Teenage aspiring athlete from MP earns David Beckham's praise after stopping her child marriage
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl from Madhya Pradesh has drawn international attention after refusing to let her family's marriage plans interrupt her education, with former England football captain David Beckham sharing her story on social media to mark World Children's Day. Hima Ninama, a resident of Barkheda village in Jhabua district, stood up against her proposed child marriage while studying in Class 11.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why we feel sleepier in a moving car even when we are well-rested
stories.summary: From engine vibrations to monotonous motion, here are the reasons why car rides often make us feel sleepy. Do you also feel sleepy while travelling in a car? You are not the only one to feel that. Feeling sleepy in a moving vehicle is a combination of several factors.

stories.title: Inside COP31’s last 50 hours: A day of waiting, a 3am text, and ‘Simon, take your seat’ | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations climate conference (COP31) in Türkiye's Antalya was supposed to conclude on Friday, November 20, and bring about a negotiated outcome document. It did neither. Delegates spent two more days waiting for texts that came late or not at all, often with little idea of who was negotiating what.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: How real is 'Dhurandhar'? Retired Colonel Hunny Bakshi clarifies Ranveer Singh-starrer is fictional narra
stories.summary: He clarified in a recent interview that although the story draws inspiration from actual incidents, its presentation has been shaped through creative imagination. The franchise has attracted considerable attention for its portrayal of geopolitical developments, national security issues and events connected to Pakistan. Speaking at the ANI National Security Summit, Colonel Hunny Bakshi (Retd) explained the distinction between actual events and their cinematic treatment.

stories.title: With AI, scientists may solve their hardest problems faster than they can understand why | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Two prestigious unsolved problems in mathematics may have been solved with the help of AI in the past week, although the author of one of the proofs said he cannot yet fully explain it. Every school student learns that an answer without the working earns few marks, since the working is how a teacher follows the reasoning.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: Inside Trump's Secret Mission to Bring Jensen Huang Back To Nvidia | Explained
stories.summary: S. President Donald Trump personally intervened to orchestrate Jensen Huang’s stunning return as chief executive of Nvidia—just 11 days after the tech boss resigned amid an intelligence scandal—according to a CNN report detailing a weekend-long White House pressure campaign. S. economy, and America’s lead in the global AI race, Trump contacted Nvidia’s board directly—even dialing into a board meeting—while assigning Vice President JD Vance to coordinate an intensive 72-hour push with directors.

stories.title: Explainer-What are the disputes between Iraq’s federal government and Kurdistan region?
stories.summary: The orders are part of a broader crackdown by Zaidi against oil smuggling. They also reopen long-running disputes between Baghdad and the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) over control of oil, money, territory and trade. Though Baghdad says state oil marketer SOMO has sole authority to export Iraq’s crude, for years the KRG exported independently through a pipeline to Turkey’s Ceyhan port.

stories.title: Year-round tax planning for salaried employees: a 12-month approach explained
stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The second is your home, and the loan that usually comes with it. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Cases against Megaspeed, the Singapore firm tied to Jensen Huang’s brief ouster from Nvidia | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The US on Monday blacklisted Megaspeed International, the Singapore company whose former chief executive's affair with Jensen Huang led to his brief ouster from Nvidia , as an investigation continues into whether it moved the American firm's AI chips into China. Nvidia reinstated Huang the same day the US announced its decision.

stories.title: What lies beyond Wayanad’s misty mountains?
stories.summary: The path narrows between rows of dark-green coffee bushes. The low branches of pepper sag under tight clusters of unripe green cherries. Spiders hang their webs between the plants and along the poles. ,” says one visitor, ducking the hanging web, afraid to break it. Arun George, the owner of GP Ecotic Land, Coffee and Eco Tourism, in Kattikulam, Wayanad explains how a chemical spray would have cleared them away.

stories.title: How many calories does an Indian body burn? This room may tell us
stories.summary: How many calories does your body burn while you sleep? Does an Indian diet trigger a different metabolic response from a Western diet? Why does one person gain weight despite eating seemingly little, while another stays lean despite eating more? And how much does a sedentary lifestyle change the body's energy requirements?

stories.title: How did Jensen Huang get his Nvidia CEO job back in just 11 days?
stories.summary: The board now says input from senior levels of the US government leaves it confident his return poses no national security risk. Huang still faces questions from Congress, a California subpoena and an inquiry inside Nvidia. The New York Times reported on October 29 that US officials had concluded Alice Huang, an executive at data-centre firm Megaspeed, was passing information to Beijing, and that she and Huang were close.

stories.title: Can you play as Jason and Lucia together in GTA 6? Character-switching explained
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 gives players two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who share a story and work together as partners. But can players actually take control of both characters at the same time? The answer is yes and no. GTA 6 allows players to bring Jason and Lucia together for activities, missions and robberies, but they cannot directly control both characters simultaneously.

stories.title: Who is Harpreet Singh Bhatia? Former India U-19 cricketer who hit a 120-ball 100 for UAE against India A
stories.summary: Harpreet Singh Bhatia, once regarded as one of India’s promising young batting talents, found himself up against his former cricketing countrymen on Tuesday, scoring a 100 off 120 balls, with 11 fours and a six, for the UAE against India A in a must-win Group B encounter at the Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 in Doha.

stories.title: ‘Portfolio rebalancing’: JioStar to lay off around 150 employees this week - what we know
stories.summary: JioStar, the largest media and entertainment company in India, is set to undertake another round of layoffs this week. According to Exchange4media, around 150 employees would be affected by the layoffs, expected this week. The report, citing top sources at JioStar , said that the layoff is expected to span multiple functions, including marketing, production, studios and other operational departments.

stories.title: Aboard the newly-launched Cordelia Sky’s Mumbai weekend cruise
stories.summary: Cordelia Sky is enormous. I get an idea of its magnitude from the embarkation lounge. As I board my first cruiseliner, flashes from movies come to me, from the holiday reverie of Dil Dhadakne Do to the Edwardian excesses of Titanic. As I step into the ship’s circular atrium, I am greeted by smiling crew and offered a refreshing welcome drink.

stories.title: Mumbai-Pune take a walk on the wild side
stories.summary: At a time when Mumbai is grappling with rising air pollution, deteriorating AQI levels and the loss of precious green cover to infrastructure and redevelopment projects, nature walks are finding an enthusiastic audience. More Mumbai and Punekars appear keen to step away from their screens and concrete surroundings to explore the city's green pockets, mangroves, biodiversity and lesser-known natural habitats.

stories.title: Charlie Puth, Ellie Goulding to perform at inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai; check details
stories.summary: Business Today Desk Updated Nov 24, 2026 6:15 PM IST Charlie Puth, known for global hits including Attention, We Don't Talk Anymore and See You Again, expressed excitement about performing for Indian audiences. Grammy-nominated singer, songwriter and producer Charlie Puth will perform in India for the first time on February 13, 2027, headlining the inaugural Johnnie & Co.

stories.title: YouTuber's Chhath remarks on married women's sindoor spark outrage, FIR filed
stories.summary: Patna Cyber Police registered an FIR against YouTuber Yash Maheshwari for making derogatory remarks about women. The comments were made during a stand-up performance, which caused significant public outrage. Following the controversy, Maheshwari issued a public apology acknowledging the inappropriateness of his remarks. The Bihar State Women's Commission has also demanded strict action and removal of the video.
